overall.rationale: Unresearched, not unattractive. Baby & child is one of two segments in the taxonomy with zero DataPoints on both sides of the corridor, no register entry in either geography, and no sub-segment structure defined in taxonomy.yaml to hang partial research on. It also leaves no trace in Korea's export breakdown, so the trade-flow shortcut that produced first data points for oral care and bath & shower is not available here. Any characterisation of this market would be fabrication until a fetcher run or manual drop lands.
